Patrick Donegan, Assistant City Attorney, opened the floor for nominations for Chair and Vice Chair.

1.  RECOMMENDATION TO ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. 2022­03, RECOMMENDING APPROVAL
  TO THE HAWAIIAN GARDENS CITY COUNCIL OF GENERAL PLAN AMENDMENT 2022­01,
  (THE 2021­ 2029 6TH CYCLE HOUSING ELEMENT UPDATE) AND RECOMMENDING
  APPROVAL OF THE NEGATIVE DECLARATION FOR THE DRAFT HOUSING ELEMENT; AND
  MAKE A RECOMMENDATION OF APPROVAL TO THE CITY COUNCIL FOR THE PROPOSED
  PROJECT AND ITS RELATED APPLICATION REQUESTS
  SUGGESTED ACTION: Staff’s recommendation to the Planning Commission is to approve the
  attached resolution with direction to staff to possibly revise the formatting, reiterate certain data or
  analysis as requested by HCD and/or provide more data and analysis where appropriate to
  address HCD’s concerns. The foundational policies and programs – which is the heart of what the
  Planning Commission is being asked to review and recommend approval of – will all remain the
  same.
